blocks.text: GENERAL SANTOS CITY — A nationwide campus tour is reaching out to young Filipinos to discuss the West Philippine Sea, government accountability and the 2028 elections, as organizers seek to encourage Gen Z voters to take a more active interest in national affairs. Team Pinas brought its “GenZennial Tour” to Mindanao State University-General Santos City on Wednesday, combining discussions on national issues with performances and activities designed for young audiences.
